Endless Options on 1362m² of Victoria Avenue

Set peacefully off prestigious Victoria Avenue, this Mediterranean-inspired residence embodies timeless elegance, where architectural distinction meets comfortable living to create a home that is as refined as it is inviting. From its elevated position, the home captures stunning views across the northern slopes of Remuera and towards Mount Hobson. Set across a substantial 1362m² landholding, the property offers remarkable flexibility and long-term appeal, whether to enjoy the home as it is, landbank or bring your architect and design a new home of significant scale that incorporates the lower landscaped section. Bathed in afternoon sun, the expansive rear grounds offer a playground-like environment for children to explore and enjoy. Subject to council consent, this landholding could offer a range of future possibilities. Originally built in the 1940s and thoughtfully extended in the 1970s, the house has been carefully maintained and sympathetically updated over time. Elegant arches and its distinctive Art Deco style give the home a character that will appeal to those with an appreciation for this era of design. Light-filled and generously proportioned, the versatile living spaces flow with ease, offering space for family life and entertaining. Upstairs, four well-appointed bedrooms enjoy leafy outlooks, while a fifth room on the ground floor currently serves as a home office. A dedicated media and games room adds further flexibility, while the main living areas extend to a sun-drenched, west-facing deck overlooking the Mediterranean-style swimming pool. A separate pool room enhances the outdoor experience, ideal for leisure and relaxation. Moments away from Remuera Village, the property is within the Double Grammar Zone, while also within walking distance to leading private schools. With the vendors now based overseas, this exceptional home presents a unique chance to secure a distinguished address in the heart of Remuera. Combining architectural elegance, generous living and versatile long-term potential, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy today and envision tomorrow. Please phone for viewing times....
